summary: Release 2.5 revision 10 is READY_TO_FREEZE. GLM 5.3 independently accepted the revision-9 ownership and parent-child cleanup remediation and accepted the bounded revision-10 hygiene delta in session ses_fc497522bffeicoAnsssmxJVuT. Grok 4.6 xhigh independently confirmed that both revision-8 Medium findings remain closed, the ordinary-workflow no-state fixture belongs to WS25-02, all three incident artifact digests are bound without a count mismatch, and plan review identity is bound to this report. No open Medium or High finding remains.

dimensions.rationale: All six requirements map to seven acceptance criteria, seven evidence routes, one owning workstream each and matching final-audit gates. Incident reproduction and ordinary-no-state behavior are explicitly accepted by WS25-02.

WS25-01 owns protocol contracts, WS25-02 owns runtime, cleanup and incident fixtures, and WS25-03 owns documentation and publication. The accepted plans tree and shared process boundary remain read-only; .alk and out remain forbidden writes.

Targeted runtime, cleanup, CLI, process-boundary, full-suite, dependency, complexity, documentation, neutrality and publication gates are executable and fail closed. Publication checks are expected to fail on the 2.4.1 base until WS25-03.

Private 0700/0600 state, normalized non-symlink identities, immutable attempts, process-group cleanup, parent-terminal child cancellation, post-cancel write rejection, bounded artifacts and no acceptance effect from partial output are required.

The manifest is bound to the accepted Release 2.4.1 merge dd5f08617a35b88b04f7e735906333c069029a1e. Runtime dependencies stay empty, synchronous Release 1.88 checks remain unchanged and unused workflows allocate no external-job state.

planReview.report and planFiles bind tasks/release-2-5/plan-review-r10.json, reviewedRevision equals planRevision 10, the list is lexicographic, and reviewedPlanHash matches the current manifest digest f3812d12192d0274be207f018e21ba0c15e082faadcbb9e882db849a0225589e.

findings.message: Revision 8 assigned process-limit and incident-reproduction evidence to workstreams without write authority over the runtime and cleanup fixtures.
findings.requiredAction: Revision 10 keeps AC25-LIMITS, AC25-QUALIFICATION and AC25-INCIDENTS with WS25-02, which owns the runtime and all corresponding fixture paths.

findings.message: Revision 8 did not require a terminal parent to cancel and account for every declared child job.
findings.requiredAction: Revision 10 requires parent-terminal child cancellation, blocks parent success while any child remains live and keeps partial child output diagnostic-only across requirements, acceptance, evidence and final gates.

findings.message: Revision 9 claimed that unused ordinary workflows create no external-job state without naming a deterministic fixture.
findings.requiredAction: Revision 10 adds the negative fixture to WS25-02-owned EV25-INCIDENTS and the matching acceptance and final-audit gates.

findings.message: The three source artifact digests are locally bound and intentionally cannot be re-hashed from a clean checkout.
findings.requiredAction: Use the bound incident shapes for planning and require tracked synthetic no-provider conformance evidence from WS25-02 before acceptance.
